en.title: Scaling Large Reasoning Models beyond Human Supervision: A Path toward Superintelligence
en.hook: Learn how reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pushes mathematical and coding reasoning beyond human limits.
key_takeaways: Applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to large reasoning models
Explores pathways to bypass human supervision limitations for superintelligence
Substantially improves performance in mathematics and code reasoning domains

探索超越人类监督限制以实现超级智能的途径
大幅提升数学和代码推理领域的性能
